description: Develops the one-right-vertex deletion family: unchanged optimum for unmatched deletion, the single missing copied-assignment pair after matched deletion, one weighted augmenting-path repair, the family-wide work count and exact existing Lean and Rust proof boundaries.

related_resources.reason: Pinned arXiv v4, Section 4, Algorithm 2, Lemmas 5 and 6, and the exact matching source crosswalk.

learning_objectives: Identify one-vertex deletion families in the right-root orientation of the 2016 tree recurrence
Prove optimal matching reuse after deleting an unmatched vertex and bound the number of affected deletions
Explain the one-pair copied-assignment deficit and primal-dual augmentation under preserved feasible/tight certificates
Derive Lemma 6 family cost and distinguish proved mathematical, verified integer reference and open production/runtime layers
